summary: All four occurrences checked. Active II mbalaqla has the camel as actor and its possessed eyes as object; Detransitive mbalqi has the eyes as plural subject. The possessive suffix indexes the animal but does not turn its eyes into an experiencer argument.

Both an involuntary change and the ensuing open-eye state are attested. Keep inherited Detransitive Preterit/Infectum labels; do not classify them as Part. Pass. solely because German uses an adjective.
